title: Technical Oversight Inspection Field Record
description: Completed by Civil Engineering Consultant (CEC) quarterly. Annual PCI Survey in October. Written TOI Report

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

sections.title: SECTION A — RUNWAY 07/25: ASPHALT DISTRESS SURVEY (Per ASTM D5340 / AC 150/5320-17A Appendix A)

items.text: Alligator (fatigue) cracking record area (m²) and severity (Low / Medium / High)
Bleeding / flushing asphalt binder pushed to surface; record area and location
Block cracking rectangular crack pattern not at joints; record area (m²)
Bumps and sags record location and height differential (mm)
Corrugation transverse rippling; record wavelength and depth
Depression measure maximum water depth accumulation (mm) and area (m²)
Edge cracking record length (m) and distance from pavement edge
Joint / reflection cracking cracks mirroring underlying layer joints; record length (m) and width (mm)
Lane / shoulder drop-off measure differential elevation (mm) between pavement edge and shoulder
Longitudinal and transverse cracking record length (m), width (mm) and severity
Patching assesses condition of all existing patches (Good / Moderate / Deteriorated)
Polished aggregate / low friction notes extent and proximity to touchdown zone
Pothole record count, and for each: length × width × depth (mm)
Raveling / weathering record area (m²) and severity
Rutting measure maximum rut depth (mm) with 1.2 m straightedge; record wheel path location
Shoving plastic displacement of surface in direction of traffic; record location
Slippage cracking crescent-shaped cracks in direction of travel; record location
Swell bulge or upward displacement; record location and height
Rubber deposits Touchdown Zone 07: Visual Rating: None / Low / Medium / High
Rubber deposits Touchdown Zone 25: Visual Rating: None / Low / Medium / High
Friction Assessment recommendation: None ☐ Recommended to COO ☐ (if High rubber or reduced texture)

sections.title: SECTION B — RUNWAY STRIP, RESA, SHOULDERS (CEC ENGINEERING ASSESSMENT)

items.text: Runway shoulder condition correct elevation (within 25 mm below runway edge)
Runway shoulder no erosion undermining pavement edge on either side
RESA (Threshold 07): ground bearing appears adequate no soft spots or subsidence
RESA (Threshold 07): obstacle height compliant no objects > 7.5 cm
RESA (Threshold 25): ground bearing appears adequate no soft spots or subsidence
RESA (Threshold 25): obstacle height compliant no objects > 7.5 cm
Runway strip ground surface within graded area level and obstacle- free

sections.title: SECTION C — TAXIWAYS (ALPHA, BRAVO, CHARLIE): CONCRETE DISTRESS SURVEY (Per ASTM D5340 / AC 150/5320-17A Appendix B)

items.text: Blowup / buckling sudden upward displacement at joints; record location
Corner break triangular piece broken from slab corner; record count and slab ID
Divided slab full-depth cracks in 4+ pieces; record count
Durability (D-cracking) closely spaced cracking parallel to joints; record area
Faulting differential elevation at joints; measure with straightedge (mm); record all joints > 6 mm
Joint seal damage inspects ALL joints: rate each section as Good / Cracked / Missing / Extruded
Large patch assess condition of all existing patches > 0.1 m²
Linear cracking record length (m), width (mm); assess if full-depth
Shrinkage / map cracking hairline network cracking on slab surface; record area (m²)
Popouts broken pieces pulled from slab surface; record count per 10 m²
Pumping evidence of water/fines ejected at joints; check with wheel loading
Shattered slab multiple intersecting cracks; record count
Spalling (corner) fragment broken from corner without full-depth crack; record count
Spalling (joint) concrete broken along joint edge; record linear meters per joint
Alkali-silica reaction (ASR) map cracking with gel staining near aggregate; record if suspected
Turn pad Threshold 07: surface distress survey per Section C above (PCC) complete
Turn pad Threshold 25: surface distress survey per Section C above (PCC) complete
Both turn pads: joint sealant condition assessed
Both turn pads: drainage adequate, no standing water
Full distress survey completed for all apron slabs per Section C methodology
All joint conditions mapped and rated
Drainage channels and sumps structurally sound and at correct grade
Evidence of differential settlement between stands or between aprons and taxiway junction
Fuel/oil contamination zones record area and recommend surface treatment if warranted
Retroreflectivity measurements conducted (if retroreflectometer available): record values
Runway centerline dimensions per BCAR-14 / FAA AC 150/5340-1M; condition
Threshold bar count and dimensions compliant with BCAR-14
Aiming point dimensions compliant with BCAR-14
Touchdown zone markings dimensions compliant
Holding position markings correct geometry and color on all intersections
Taxiway centerlines width and continuity compliant
Paint showing crazing, peeling, or delamination from surface record location
Markings obscured by rubber deposits record length affected (m) by zone
Apron markings stand layout conforming to approved apron design plan

sections.title: SECTION G — DRAINAGE STRUCTURAL ASSESSMENT (Annual: March / September)

items.text: All runway edge channels: slope ≥ 1%, structurally sound, headwalls intact
All taxiway drainage gutters: slope ≥ 1%, clear of sediment, structurally sound
Apron drainage channels: slope ≥ 1%, all sumps accessible and clear
All culverts: structurally sound pipes, clear inverts, intact headwalls and wingwalls
No evidence of subsurface voids (detected by hammer sounding adjacent to pavement joints)
No evidence of pavement edge erosion creating differential between pavement and shoulder
Saturated Zone Map updated new zones or expansion of existing zones documented

sections.title: SECTION H — AIRFIELD SIGNS (CEC ANNUAL STRUCTURAL ASSESSMENT)

items.text: All mandatory instruction signs structures base integrity sound, no corrosion affecting structural adequacy
All mandatory signs face panels intact, correctly dimensioned, legend and colors correct per BCAR-14
All location signs face panels intact, dimensions correct
All direction signs face panels intact, arrows correct, dimensions correct
All runway distance remaining signs present, correct numerals, positions correct
No signs with inadequate setback from pavement edge creating FOD or collision risk
